```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  fig.align = "centre"
)

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(nlea)
library(patchwork)

theme_set(theme_bw())

# Colour palette for functional groups
col1 <- c(
  "#88CCEE",  # light blue  SM BEN
  "#44AA99",  # teal        MED BEN
  "#117733",  # green       LG BEN
  "#332288",  # dark blue   PISC
  "#D55E00",  # orange      PLANKPISC
  "#FFC125",  # mustard     PLANK FIXX
  "#AA4499",  # purple      SHELLFISH
  "black",    # black       TOTAL BIOMASS
  "#0000FF"   # blue        FINFISH
)
names(col1) <- c("Small Benthivore","Medium Benthivore","Large Benthivore",
                 "Piscivore","PlankPiscivore","Planktivores","Shellfish",
                 "Total Biomass", "Finfish")

# Map EPU numbers to series names
series_map <- list(
  "1" = "2H_Fall",
  "2" = "2J3K_Fall",
  "3" = "2J3KL_Fall",
  "4" = "3LNO_Fall",
  "5" = "3LNO_Spring",
  "6" = "3NO_Spring",
  "7" = "3Ps_Spring"
)
```

# Biomass Trends with Confidence Intervals

This report shows RV biomass trends for each functional group across different survey series/EPUs. Each series is plotted with confidence interval ribbons (for multi-year sequences) or error bars (for single years).

```{r faceted_plots, results = 'asis', fig.width = 8, fig.height = 6}
for(series_name in unlist(series_map)){
  cat(sprintf("\n## %s\n\n", gsub("_", " ", series_name)))
  
  p <- plot_biomass_faceted(
    fg_biomass,
    series_filter = series_name,
    min_year = 1995,
    campelen_only = TRUE
  )
  
  print(p)
  
  cat("\n\n")
}
```

# Biomass Composition by Series

The following plot shows the proportional composition of biomass across functional groups for selected survey series (Campelen gear, 1995+).

```{r composition_data_prep}
# Prepare composition data for all series
composition_data <- fg_biomass %>%
  dplyr::filter(gear == "Campelen", year >= 1995) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(series, year) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    total_biomass = sum(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    prop = value / total_biomass
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::filter(!(fg %in% c("Total Biomass", "Finfish"))) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    fg = factor(fg, levels = c("Small Benthivore", "Medium Benthivore", "Large Benthivore",
                               "Piscivore", "PlankPiscivore", "Planktivores", "Shellfish"))
  )

# Select key series for the faceted composition plot
selected_series <- c("2H_Fall", "2J3K_Fall", "3LNO_Fall", "3Ps_Spring")

composition_data_selected <- composition_data %>%
  dplyr::filter(series %in% selected_series) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    series = case_when(
      series == "2H_Fall" ~ "Div. 2H Fall",
      series == "2J3K_Fall" ~ "Div. 2J3K Fall",
      series == "3LNO_Fall" ~ "Div. 3LNO Fall",
      series == "3Ps_Spring" ~ "Div. 3Ps Spring",
      TRUE ~ series
    )
  )
```

```{r composition_plot, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 6}
ggplot(
  composition_data_selected,
  aes(
    x = year,
    y = prop,
    fill = fg,
    colour = fg
  )
) +
  geom_col(
    width = 1,
    position = position_stack(reverse = TRUE),
    alpha = 0.75
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = col1,
    breaks = rev(names(col1)),
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = col1,
    breaks = rev(names(col1)),
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::percent,
    limits = c(0, 1.01),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(
      min(composition_data_selected$year, na.rm = TRUE),
      max(composition_data_selected$year, na.rm = TRUE),
      by = 2
    ),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ series,
    ncol = 2
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Proportion of Biomass",
    fill = "Functional Group",
    colour = "Functional Group"
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 90,
      vjust = 0.5,
      hjust = 1,
      size = 10
    ),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )
```
